name: place_card
description: One place of a plan, with its photo and a short summary, which the phone loads from Wikipedia, so it needs no image URL. Use one per sight, beach, monastery, village or day trip.

title.description: The place's exact English Wikipedia article title, such as "Church of St. John at Kaneo"

note.description: One short line about it for this plan, such as "Best at sunset" or "2 hours"

events.name: ask_about
events.description: Tapping the card asks you about the place.

name: trip_map
description: A map of a plan with a pin for each place, drawn on the phone. Use one near the top of every trip plan.

places.description: Every place of the plan, with its coordinates

events.name: select_place
events.description: Tapping a pin asks you about that place.

name: calendar_check
description: The person's own calendar for the days of a plan, read on the phone. You never see it: use it whenever a plan has dates, so they can see what the trip would clash with.

name: restaurant_card
description: Venue summary card showing restaurant name, cuisine, star rating, and optional price tier.

name.description: Restaurant name, such as "Kaneo Cliffside Kitchen"

cuisine.description: Cuisine and distance summary, such as "Macedonian Grill · 1.2 km"

rating.description: Star rating from 0 to 5, such as 4.9

events.name: inspect_venue
events.description: Tapping the restaurant card asks for its menu and highlights.

name: availability_gauge
description: Live radial occupancy and wait-time gauge for a restaurant or booking venue.

wait_label.description: Estimated wait time label, such as "12 min wait"

name: seat_selector
description: Interactive floorplan zone and table selector for choosing a specific dining area.

tables.description: Available and occupied tables by zone and seat count

events.name: select_table
events.description: Tapping an available table requests that table zone.
